body.prose:
How glass came to be what it is, told over its commits, newest first, each day by the runs of work it held, with the commits standing beneath as leaves. It is kept in markdown and git, the substrate glass has now, and moves into the store once the store is built; there is no need to move it sooner.

*Begun 2026-11-02, on the author's word that the effort be noted in the log as the work goes. Each story reasoned by the session that did the work, from the commits and the author's words.*
body.title: History
